scores.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage aggregation across tool rounds and covers the acceptance scenarios with unit and integration tests. However, `src/types/ai.ts` contains an accidental duplicate declaration of `export interface TotalUsage`, `chatOrchestrator.ts` leaves `UsageMetadata` as a potentially unused import after switching to `TotalUsage`, and `.lore/dod.md` is left tracked in the diff. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate leaves the `afterModelResponse` behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading instead of promoting it to the main specification section and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` as the reference did. Finally, while introducing a `TotalUsage` interface satisfies the requirement to make the hook signature unambiguous, the reference achieved this more simply by renaming the hook parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and keeping the helper local to `chatOrchestrator.ts`.
